name: Topaz Bloom (upscale)
description: Topaz Labs' creative upscalers (Bloom 2, Bloom, Bloom Realism) through fal.ai: adds detail, may change small things. Topaz can take several minutes on a large picture; the window stays usable while it runs. Written from the provider's schema and not run against the live API yet.

fal.note: topaz/upscale/image/creative on fal: 1 to 4 times; Creativity (1 to 9) applies to Bloom 2 only. Upscale (the button next to Generate) runs it on the selection, which comes back sharper at the document's resolution, or on the whole picture, which becomes N times larger with every layer scaled along.
